title: Scale RRF vector weight by cosine margin and down-weight unrequested block hits

sections.what: Weight vector RRF contributions by cosine margin (sim - MIN_SIMILARITY) / (K + rank) and down-weight kind=block hits by 0.5x unless kind=block is explicitly requested.
sections.why: Small-bucket rank #1 in vec:function (e.g. 0.46 cosine on a 3-line markdown code fence) currently gets the same RRF score as rank #1 in vec:comment, crowding out genuine prose sections.
sections.verify: Run pytest tests/test_codesearch_db.py covering cosine-margin RRF weighting and kind=block down-weighting.

acceptance.text: Vector RRF contributions scale with cosine margin above MIN_SIMILARITY rather than flat 1/(K+rank).
Markdown code-fence block nodes are down-weighted (e.g. 0.5x) unless kind=block is explicitly requested.
Unit tests verify strong vec:comment prose sections outrank mediocre vec:function code-fence blocks on markdown searches.

evidence: Weighted RRF vector contributions by cosine margin above MIN_SIMILARITY in Searcher.search() (src/codesearch/search.py).
Added BLOCK_UNREQUESTED_WEIGHT (0.5x) in src/codesearch/config.py and Searcher._block_node_ids() down-weighting when kind='block' is not requested.
